drafted_from: workflow:out-launch-a-new-launch's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its job, input schema and the step named in the worked example)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:out-launch-a-new-launch for a bakery ordering app, watching Show HN and Product Hunt, posting on a newsletter and a video channel."
no_lists_because: It reads the person's own Sources I watch list and keeps each teardown as a row of their own Library list, so it ships no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Add the places that launch products as rows of your Sources I watch list (Show HN, Product Hunt and Launch YC start there turned off; turn on the ones you want).

2. Say "Run workflow:out-launch-a-new-launch" with market (what you sell and to whom), channels (where you post) and, when you have them, match_words, sources, own_product, licence, target_hours and deadline_hours; it is meant to wake every hour.

3. Each run reads the launches of the last 24 hours (read-launches), keeps only those whose own page overlaps your market (match) and tears each one down from public evidence, SEEN apart from INFERRED, as a row of your Library list (reverse-engineer).
4. Read each counter-launch it drafts (counter-launch) and approve or turn it down; nothing goes out without your approval and nobody is contacted.

5. Each approved one is handed off as a launch record that starts workflow:plan-a-launch-as-a-content-campaign (hand-off); timing reports hours to teardown and hand-off against the 1-hour target and 24-hour deadline.

worked_examples.title: Keep only the launch whose own page overlaps the market
worked_examples.ask: Run workflow:out-launch-a-new-launch for a bakery ordering app.

input.market: An ordering app for small neighbourhood bakeries

worked_examples.given: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json, step match: for each launch read-launches found, it reads the launch's own page with tool:read-public-web-page and keeps it only when its own words overlap the market and hold one match word. Say read-launches found two launches: "Crumb" on Show HN and "Tidal Notes", a note app.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"matches":[{"key":"show-hn:crumb","source":"show-hn","name":"Crumb","url":"https://example.com/crumb","launched_at":"2026-11-13T09:10:00-06:00","hours_since_launch":2.5,"overlap_quote":"Crumb lets a neighbourhood bakery take pre-orders for tomorrow's loaves.","why":"It sells pre-orders to small bakeries, the same buyer as the market."}],"passed":[{"key":"show-hn:tidal-notes","reason":"A note-taking app for students, a different buyer and a different job."}]}
